The Q2 values only match after three adjustments, so I applied all three to Q3:

- **Customers counted by email:** the 300 customer IDs share only 250 distinct emails (after trimming spaces and ignoring case). Without merging by email, Q2 gave 278 and 227 for b and f instead of your 235 and 196. I used the same email grouping for e.
- **Segment and category names normalized:** values like "SMB", "Enterprise " and " consumer" were trimmed and lowercased.
